site_name: 2C Marquis Road, Wood Green, London, N22 8JH
description:
Application for a certificate of Lawfulness Development (Proposed) with respect to a change of use from a dwellinghouse (use class C3) to children care home (use class C2).

Lawful development: Proposed use.
A Lawful Development Certificate should be granted because the proposed use does not constitute a material change of use in planning terms. The existing property is a lawful Class C3(a) dwellinghouse, and the proposed occupation by up to four young people (aged 7–17) together with one permanent live-in carer would, as a matter of fact and degree, operate in a manner consistent with a typical family household. All communal facilities would be shared, daily routines would mirror those of an ordinary family, and there are no external alterations or operational works proposed. - For full details, please refer to the planning statement accompanying this application.
